Janmashtami Celebrated Across India with Religious Observances

Across India, communities celebrated the festival of Janmashtami with religious fervor. In Hazaribagh, preparations for Durga Puja began alongside Janmashtami celebrations, marked by a traditional 'Kath Puja' ceremony by the Durga Puja Mahasamiti, which is celebrating its 26th anniversary. In Kashi, devotees participated in the Mangla Aarti where Laddu Gopal was placed alongside Baba Vishwanath. Rajasthan witnessed a 21-gun salute for Shri Nathji during the Janmashtami festivities.
